AC Amendment (gap analysis): 
1. Each test function MUST run the script in an isolated environment. Use a subshell or  to prevent DSO_FILING_CONTEXT from leaking between tests. Example: `result=$(env -i DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=mutation-auto-bug bash plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh)`. test_empty_context_maps_to_other MUST explicitly unset DSO_FILING_CONTEXT or use `env -i bash plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh`.
2. All output comparisons MUST use command substitution: `[ "$(env -i ... bash plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh)" = "tests" ]`. Do NOT use diff or grep-based comparison — command substitution strips trailing newlines, avoiding format mismatches.
3. Invoke the script via the relative path `plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh` (same resolution context as callers in SKILL.md), not a hardcoded absolute path.
